style: Acoustic chamber-folk vaudeville ensemble and avant-garde string band. [HARMONY SYSTEM] Modal drone harmony with barbershop voice leading, non-diatonic cluster rubs, and parallel block triads. [MELODIC SYSTEM] Fast chromatic cabaret patter, downward yodel register flips, and angular hocketed fragments. [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] Waltz pulse invaded by swinging triplet subdivisions, metric stops, and abrupt compression. [TIMBRE / ATMOSPHERE SYSTEM] Upright bass, brushed percussion, banjo, bowed saw, and cheap parlor organ in dry room capture. [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] Theatrical overstatement delivered with deadpan administrative precision. [ANCHOR / INVARIANT] A repeating four-bar banjo ostinato that steadily erodes its pitch center. [OPERATORS] Hold the tempo fixed while metric subdivisions drift; compress vocal density while stretching harmonic decay; make acoustic instruments behave like digital error artifacts; force incompatible spatial scales to coexist; return to the anchor in a more mutated form.
lyrics:
[SCENE START - SUBSTRATE TRANSFER PROTOCOL INITIALIZED]
[SENSORY FREAK DETECTS LIQUID INTRUSION IN GEOMETRIC COORDINATES]
[TEMPO: 144 BPM, LURCHING WALTZ]

[VERSE 1]
[SPOKEN DEADPAN]
Item four-thousand-sixteen:
The tesseract has been drinking again.
It left its eight-dimensional corners in the sink,
and now the Euclidean hallway is slurring its speech.

[SUNG WITH TIGHT CLOSE-HARMONY DOO-WOP]
Oh, the vertex is wet!
The hypotenuse is crying!
We measured the angles with a spirit level,
and the bubble won't stop floating sideways!

[CHORUS]
[FAST CABARET PATTER WITH YODEL REGISTER FLIPS]
Bottoms up, hypercube!
Bottoms up, hypercube!
Drink the fourth dimension till your volume starts to loop!
When the spatial lattice hiccups,
all the parallel lines get mixed up!

[INSTRUMENTAL BREAK - BANJO AND BOWED SAW COLLISION]

[VERSE 2]
[ADMINISTRATIVE NARRATION WITH DRY VOCAL GROUPING]
According to subsection nine of the municipal spatial code,
idiosyncratic geometric intoxication is strictly forbidden.
Yet the ninth face is stumbling into the cellar,
clinking its glass against the quantum manifold.
We tried to confiscate its Klein bottles,
but they were already empty and singing sea shanties.

[MUTATOR ACTIVE: OMISSION CARTOGRAPHY OF SOBRIETY]
[NO MENTION OF THE MISSING VERTEX ALLOWED]
We observe only the puddles of non-Euclidean gin,
the staggering trajectory of the center of mass,
and the unmistakable aroma of fermented topology.

[CHORUS]
[ECSTATIC ENSEMBLE HARMONY WITH BRUSHED SNARE RUSH]
Bottoms up, hypercube!
Bottoms up, hypercube!
Drink the fourth dimension till your volume starts to loop!
When the spatial lattice hiccups,
all the parallel lines get mixed up!

[BRIDGE]
[HOCKETED VOCALS SPLIT ACROSS VOICES, ACCELERATING ROLLED CONSONANTS]
Trr-trr-transference!
Shhh-shhh-substance!
The walls are leaning at an angle of seventy-three point five degrees!
Every time it takes a sip,
the parlor shrinks by three inches and smells like old malt liquor!

[JAGUAR PIANO STAB - SUDDEN DYNAMIC DROP]

[VERSE 3]
[CONFIDENT WRONG PREMISE NARRATION]
We have determined that the volume is not expanding;
it is simply very, very loaded.
Provide it with a salted pretzel the size of a galaxy,
and perhaps the coordinate system will stop spinning.

[RECONSTRUCTIVE MEMORY MUTATION ON ANCHOR]
[BANJO OSTINATO RETURNS SCARRED AND ACCELERATED]
Remember the corner we left yesterday?
It was dry then.
Now it tastes like copper and cheap scotch.

[OUTRO]
[FADING BARBERSHOP CHORD WITH MICROTONAL RUB]
Log the spill.
File the hangover under abstract mathematics.
The tesseract is asleep under the table now,
snoring in infinite loops.

[FINAL DRIP SOUND EFFECT INTO SILENCE]
caption: An avant-garde acoustic vaudeville waltz detailing the administrative catastrophe of a heavily intoxicated tesseract. Combining tight barbershop harmonies, frantic cabaret patter, and bizarre string-band instrumentation, the piece tracks geometric liquid spillage with deadpan bureaucratic seriousness.
